title.en: An Act Establishing a National High School in Barangay Kalanawe II, Municipality of President Quirino, Province of Sultan Kudarat, to Be Known as the Kalanawe II National High School
title.orig: An Act Establishing a National High School in Barangay Kalanawe II, Municipality of President Quirino, Province of Sultan Kudarat, to Be Known as the Kalanawe II National High School
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia tại Barangay Kalanawe II, Thị trấn President Quirino, Tỉnh Sultan Kudarat được biết đến với tên gọi Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia Kalanawe II
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Kalanawe II, เทศบาล President Quirino, จังหวัด Sultan Kudarat ให้เป็นที่รู้จักในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติ Kalanawe II
title.id: Undang-Undang mendirikan Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional di Barangay Kalanawe II, Kotamadya President Quirino, Provinsi Sultan Kudarat dikenal sebagai Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional Kalanawe II
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan di Barangay Kalanawe II, Perbandaran President Quirino, Wilayah Sultan Kudarat dikenali sebagai Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan Kalanawe II

text.en: There is hereby established a national high school in Barangay Kalanawe II, Municipality of President Quirino, Province of Sultan Kudarat, to be known as the Kalanawe II National High School, under the supervision of the Department of Education, Culture and Sports.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, November 18, 1994.
